headline: Executive order sets ethics commitments that people working in the executive branch must follow.
what_it_does: This order sets ethics commitments for people who work in the federal executive branch. Based on its title, it lays out rules or promises those workers must accept about ethical conduct. No summary was provided, so the specific rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are expected to follow the ethics commitments set out in the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 21, 2009. The provided material gives no separate start date.
